listening_1.stem: What does the customer complain about? (xem phần mô tả để biết đáp án đúng)
listening_1.description:
The Wi-Fi was too slow

I stopped by a new coffee shop yesterday to get some work done before a meeting. The coffee itself was really good, and the seats were comfortable too. But I ended up leaving earlier than planned because the wifi kept disconnecting every few minutes, and when it did work, it was extremely slow. I tried asking the staff about it, and they said a few other customers had mentioned the same problem that morning. I probably won't bring my laptop there again unless they fix the connection.

When I got there, the place was actually quieter than normal, which was nice for a change. But then I noticed a small notice on the studio door saying the yoga session had been cancelled because the instructor was sick. Nobody had messaged us about it beforehand, so I ended up just walking on the treadmill for a bit before heading home. I was a little annoyed, but these things happen sometimes.

choices: He has to drive to work

He has to drive to work

It's hard to rely on public transport if it's not reliable. Have you ever driven before? Man: Not really. I've always used buses and trains, but now it looks like I don't have a choice. I need to get a license. Woman: You'll get the hang of it. Driving will definitely make your commute easier. Are you planning to take lessons soon? Man: Yeah, I'm going to sign up for a driving school next week. Hopefully, I can get it done quickly.

listening_1.stem: James is talking about his family members. In what way does his mother and his aunt alike?
listening_1.description:
They were both thin

This picture is of my aunt and my mom. Many people say they look alike. I find it funny, though, because when they were teenagers, my mom had long hair, while my aunt had short hair. They were both equally thin back then, but their eyes were different. My mom has lovely brown eyes, and my aunt has strikingly beautiful blue eyes. Even with their differences, they share a special bond that makes them so similar in spirit.

listening_2.stem: Four people are talking about Reading. Complete the sentences below.
choices: Does not have time to read books.
Does not have time to read books.
descriptions:
Person A : Reads while travelling to work.

 

It was probably my favorite activity when I was younger. I used to spend hours reading novels and storybooks at home. These days, I'm quite busy with work, so I don't have much time to sit down and read. However, I still manage to enjoy a few pages every morning while travelling to work by bus. It's a great way to make use of my journey.

Person B : Does not have time to read books.

 

When I was a kid, I really enjoyed reading adventure stories and comics. I even had a large collection of books in my bedroom. However, my life has become much busier since I started working. I usually spend my free time doing housework or meeting friends, so I hardly ever have enough time to read books nowadays.

Person C : Prefers another activity to reading.

 

My house is full of books because I've been collecting them for many years. I particularly enjoy buying novels and keeping them on my bookshelves. Although I sometimes read a few pages before going to bed, I actually prefer watching films and listening to music. These activities help me relax much more than reading does.

Person D : Only reads children's books.

 

As I was small, my parents often bought me picture books and fairy tales. I still enjoy reading, but my interests haven't changed very much. Even though my friends recommend exciting novels and science books, I don't find them interesting. I prefer children's books because they have simple language, lovely pictures and interesting stories.

I used to go…..=> as a social activity

 

I used to go to art galleries with my friends when I was at university. We enjoyed looking at paintings and discussing different artists. Sometimes, we also attended drawing workshops together. Although I can draw quite well on my own, I find visiting exhibitions with other people much more enjoyable. It's a great way to spend time with friends and share our interests.

At school I….=> with their children

 

At school, I really enjoyed painting and making handmade things. Nowadays, I often do art activities with my children at home. We usually draw pictures, make paper animals and paint colourful decorations together. I sometimes visit art museums with my friends, but I think creating artwork with my children is much more fun. It also gives us a chance to spend quality time together.

When I was young…..=> as part of their job

 

When I was young, I was very interested in drawing and painting. I never thought I would use these skills in my future career. Now, I work as a graphic designer, so creating artwork is an important part of my daily responsibilities. Although I enjoy visiting galleries in my free time, most of my artistic activities are connected to my job.

A few colleagues in my work place…..=> alone

 

A few colleagues in my workplace enjoy painting, and they often invite me to join their art club. However, I prefer spending my free time drawing and painting by myself. I find it easier to concentrate when nobody is around. Sometimes, I listen to music while creating pictures, and I feel very relaxed. For me, art is a personal activity rather than something I need to share with others.

I was excited to……=> got lost during the visit

 

I was excited to visit the museum because I'd heard so many good things about it. There were several interesting rooms showing paintings, old objects and historical photographs. However, I didn't pay much attention to the signs and accidentally took the wrong direction. I spent quite a long time trying to find my way back to the main exhibition area. Luckily, a member of staff helped me find the exit.

A history museum….=> finish the visit quickly

 

A history museum has always been something I've wanted to explore. However, when I arrived, I found that some exhibition rooms were closed for repairs. I had planned to spend the whole afternoon there, but there wasn't as much to see as I expected. I decided to look around the main exhibition and leave after about thirty minutes. I was a little disappointed because I had expected more displays.

I thought it would be a brief visit…..=>wants to visit again

 

I thought it would be a brief visit because I only wanted to see the main exhibition. However, I was surprised by how interesting the museum was. The staff were friendly, and there were many fascinating objects from different periods. I particularly enjoyed the ancient art collection. I didn't have enough time to explore everything, so I'm planning to come back next weekend.

My visit to the museum….=> enjoy the use of technology

 

My visit to the museum was a wonderful experience. What impressed me most was the technology they used to present the exhibits. There were interactive screens, virtual reality displays and audio guides that explained the history of each object. I usually prefer looking at real objects rather than reading information boards, but these modern features made the visit much more enjoyable.

I love listening to pop music……=> while singing

 

I love listening to pop music, especially songs by my favourite singers. I usually play music when I'm doing housework or travelling by bus. Sometimes, I turn up the volume and sing along to the songs, even though I don't have a very good voice. My friends often laugh when they hear me singing, but I really enjoy doing it. Music makes my daily activities more interesting.

My brother listens to music to relax…..=>after waking up

 

My brother listens to music to relax after a long day at school, but I have a different habit. I usually turn on my favorite playlist as soon as I wake up in the morning. It helps me feel more energetic and puts me in a good mood before I start my daily activities. I sometimes listen to music while getting dressed or having breakfast.

What I love to do ….=> to relax

 

What I love to do after a stressful day is listen to soft music in my bedroom. I usually choose slow songs because they help me feel peaceful and forget about my worries. I don't really care about the type of music as long as it has a gentle melody. Although I sometimes listen to music when travelling, my favourite time is when I want to rest and relax.

Most of my friends….=> while studying

 

Most of my friends prefer listening to music when they are relaxing or doing exercise. However, I have a different habit. I often play instrumental music while studying, especially when I'm preparing for important exams. I find that songs without lyrics help me concentrate better and avoid distractions. I usually turn the volume down so that I can focus on my lessons.

There are many small things….=> using less electricity

 

There are many small things we can do to protect the environment. For example, I always turn off the lights when I leave a room and unplug electrical devices when I'm not using them. I also try to take shorter showers and avoid wasting water. Although these habits may seem simple, I believe they can make a difference. Saving energy is especially important because it helps reduce pollution.

Everybody seems to be buying things online…..=> not driving to work

 

Everybody seems to be buying things online these days, but I don't really enjoy shopping on the Internet. I prefer visiting local shops because I can choose products myself. To protect the environment, I usually take the bus instead of driving my car to work. It takes a little longer, but it helps reduce air pollution and the number of cars on the road.

I have my groceries delivered to my house….=> shopping online

 

I have my groceries delivered to my house because it saves me a lot of time. I used to drive to the supermarket several times a week, but now I can order everything online. I know delivery vehicles also produce pollution, so I try to place one large order instead of several small ones. I think shopping online is a convenient way to buy what I need.

I would love to walk or cycle to work….=> using less water

 

I would love to walk or cycle to work, but unfortunately, my office is quite far from my house. Instead, I try to protect the environment in other ways. For example, I never leave the tap running when I brush my teeth, and I always use only the amount of water I need. I also collect rainwater to water my plants. I believe everyone should try to save water in their daily lives.

choices: does not use commercial cleaning products
does not use commercial cleaning products
descriptions:
Some people buy things at charity shops….=> giving away used items

 

Some people buy things at charity shops, but I prefer giving away my used items when I no longer need them. I usually donate old clothes, books and toys to local charities. This gives these things a second life and helps people who cannot afford to buy new ones. I think it is a simple way to reduce waste.

Honestly, I don't think I have….=>does not use commercial cleaning products

 

Honestly, I don't think I have bought commercial cleaning products for years. I prefer using natural ingredients such as vinegar, lemon juice and baking soda to clean my house. They are usually cheaper and create less plastic waste. I also feel more comfortable using them because they contain fewer harsh chemicals.

I am shocked…..=> reusing containers for storing food

 

I am shocked by how many plastic containers people throw away every day. Instead of putting them in the rubbish bin, I wash and reuse them to store food in my fridge. For example, I use old glass jars for spices and plastic boxes for leftovers. This helps me save money and reduce the amount of waste I produce.

I believe consumerism…..=> worries about creating rubbish

 

I believe consumerism is one of the biggest causes of environmental problems. People often buy things they do not really need, which creates a huge amount of rubbish. I always think carefully before buying something because I don't want to contribute to this problem. I try to choose products with less packaging whenever possible.

Obviously, running in the park or forest is ideal….=> at a fitness center

 

Obviously, running in the park or forest is ideal because you can enjoy fresh air and beautiful views. However, sometimes the weather is too bad to run outside. In that case, I prefer going to a fitness center. It has treadmills and other useful equipment, so I can exercise comfortably whatever the weather is like.

I'm not a keen person myself…..=> at the seaside

 

I'm not a keen person myself when it comes to running, but I sometimes go for a run with my friends. We usually choose the seaside because the view is amazing and the fresh sea air makes us feel relaxed. Running along the beach is also a great way to enjoy nature and forget about our daily problems.

My husband and I…..=> on the street

 

My husband and I often go running together in the evening. We usually run along the streets near our house because it is convenient and we don't need to travel anywhere. However, we have to be careful of traffic, especially during rush hour. We normally choose quieter streets to stay safe.

I live by the seaside…..=> on a running track

 

I live by the seaside, so I have many beautiful places to run. However, I don't really enjoy running on the beach because the sand is too soft. Instead, I prefer going to a running track. The surface is smooth, and I can easily measure how far I run. It's also a good place to improve my speed.

I don't find it difficult concentrating…..=> in a coffee shop

 

I don't find it difficult concentrating when I'm in a coffee shop. In fact, I quite enjoy studying there because I can have a cup of coffee while reading my books. The background noise doesn't bother me. Sometimes, seeing other people working also motivates me to stay focused and finish my assignments.

Like most students I don't like…..=> in a park

 

Like most students I don't like studying in a crowded place. However, I really enjoy studying in a park when the weather is nice. I usually find a quiet bench under a tree and read my notes there. The fresh air helps me feel relaxed, and I don't get as stressed as I do indoors.

Some people find it difficult….=> on public transport

 

Some people find it difficult to study while travelling, but I actually find it quite convenient. I often review my lessons on public transport, especially when I'm taking the bus to university. Although it can be noisy sometimes, I use my headphones to concentrate. It also helps me make good use of my travelling time.

To study effectively, I need a quiet environment….=> at home 

 

To study effectively, I need a quiet environment. That's why I prefer studying at home, where I can arrange my books and everything I need. I don't have to worry about people talking or making noise around me. Besides, I can take short breaks whenever I feel tired.

I don't usually revise anything after school….=> at various places

 

I don't usually revise anything after school because I prefer taking a break first. I normally do my homework in different places depending on how I feel. Sometimes I study in my bedroom, sometimes in the library, and occasionally in a coffee shop. Changing my study environment helps me feel more interested and less bored.

I start doing my homework right away …=> in a quiet place

 

I start doing my homework right away when I get home because I don't want to leave everything until the last minute. I always choose a quiet place, usually my bedroom, where nobody can disturb me. I find it much easier to concentrate and understand difficult lessons when there is no noise around.

I know many people loose concentration….=> with music

 

I know many people lose concentration when they listen to music while studying, but I find it helpful. I usually play some soft music in the background when I do my homework. It helps me relax and makes studying less boring. However, I avoid songs with strong beats or distracting lyrics.

I study late in the evening….=> late at night

 

I study late in the evening because that's when I feel most productive. During the day, I'm usually busy with school and other activities, so I don't have much time to revise my lessons. At night, everything is quieter, and I can focus better. Sometimes, I continue studying until midnight.

We've got a lot of snow in the winter….=> going for run

 

We've got a lot of snow in the winter, so outdoor activities can sometimes be difficult. However, I still enjoy going for a run whenever the weather is suitable. I usually run around my neighbourhood or in the park. It helps me stay fit and gives me more energy. I prefer running in the early morning when the air is fresh.

There are no hills in our country….=> horse riding

 

There are no hills in our country, so horse riding is one of the most interesting outdoor activities for me. I usually go to a riding centre at weekends and spend a few hours riding horses. I really enjoy spending time with these beautiful animals. It's also a great way to relax and escape from my busy daily life.

I love the trails in the mountains….=> hiking

 

I love the trails in the mountains because they offer beautiful views and fresh air. Whenever I have free time, I enjoy hiking with my friends. We often spend several hours walking through forests and enjoying nature. Although it can be tiring, reaching the top of a mountain always makes me feel proud and happy.

The area where I live…..=> mountain biking

 

The area where I live has many forests and hills, which makes it perfect for mountain biking. I often ride my bike along narrow paths and challenging trails with my friends. It's an exciting activity because I can enjoy nature while testing my cycling skills. Of course, I always wear a helmet to stay safe.

I used to go on the internet….=> to watch films

 

I used to go on the internet mainly to read the news and check my emails, but now I spend most of my free time watching films online. There are many websites and apps where I can find movies of different types. I especially enjoy watching comedies and romantic films. It's a convenient way to relax without going to the cinema.

At our college, we had to study….=> to complete assignments

 

At our college, we had to study a lot of different subjects, and the Internet was extremely useful. Whenever we received homework or projects, I often searched online for information and materials. It helped me find useful articles, videos and examples. I could also use online dictionaries to understand difficult words and complete my assignments more effectively.

Quite a few of my friends….=> to communicate with friends

 

Quite a few of my friends live far away from me, so I often use the Internet to keep in touch with them. We usually send messages, share photos and make video calls. It's a great way to stay connected, especially when we don't have time to meet in person. Social media also helps me make new friends.

I'm not a fan of studying online…..=> to find transport information

 

I'm not a fan of studying online because I find it difficult to concentrate in front of a computer for too long. However, I use the Internet quite often when I need to travel somewhere. I can check bus and train timetables, compare ticket prices and find the best routes. This information helps me plan my journeys more easily.

Well, I really believe that….=> travel by bus

 

Well, I really believe that travelling by bus is one of the best ways to get to work. It's cheaper than driving a car, and I don't have to worry about finding a parking space. Although buses can sometimes be crowded, I usually use the journey to listen to music or read the news on my phone.

Well, I live deep in the countryside…..=> travels by car

 

Well, I live deep in the countryside, quite far away from the town where I work. There isn't a convenient bus service in my area, so I have no choice but to travel by car. It takes me about 30 minutes to get to work. I also enjoy driving because I can listen to my favorite songs along the way.

I'm a doctor….=> walks alone

 

I'm a doctor, and I usually have a busy working schedule. Luckily, the hospital is quite close to my home, so I prefer walking to work alone. I enjoy the peaceful atmosphere in the early morning, and walking gives me some time to think before starting my day. It also helps me stay healthy.

It's about three kilometers….=> walks with friends

 

It's about three kilometers from my house to the office, so I usually walk there with a couple of my friends who work nearby. We meet outside a local shop every morning and walk together. It's a good opportunity to chat, share stories and get some exercise before starting work.

choices: has fun when exercising with others
exercise to help improve work performance
has fun when exercising with others
exercise to help improve work performance
descriptions:
I'm not keen on exercising….=> exercise to help improve work performance

 

I'm not keen on exercising because I usually feel too tired after a long day at work. However, I know that doing some physical activity can actually improve my work performance. When I exercise regularly, I feel more energetic and can concentrate better. It also helps me deal with stress and stay productive throughout the day.

I'm a bit strange about exercising ….=> has fun when exercising with others

 

I'm a bit strange about exercising because I don't really enjoy doing it alone. However, when I exercise with other people, I have a great time. I often play badminton or go jogging with my friends at weekends. We encourage each other and have fun together, so exercising doesn't feel like a difficult task.

I don't feel exercising my things….=> finds it tiring

 

I don't feel exercising is my things because I find it extremely tiring. Even after a short workout, I get out of breath and my muscles start to hurt. I understand that exercise is important for our health, but I always feel exhausted afterwards. I'd rather spend my free time doing something more relaxing.

Well, you're not getting me exercising at all…. => hate exercising

 

Well, you're not getting me exercising at all! I absolutely hate doing physical activities, especially running or going to the gym. I prefer relaxing at home, watching television or reading a book. I know people say exercise is good for you, but it's simply not something I enjoy.

listening_2.stem: Four people are talking about Exercise. Complete the sentences below - Nghe hiểu

descriptions:
feels to do sufficient exercise

I enjoy playing sports, especially badminton and swimming. I try to stay active whenever I have free time. However, I sometimes feel that I'm not doing enough exercise to maintain good health. I know I should be more active, so I'm planning to spend more time working out every week.

likes exercising alone

I used to exercise with my friends, but now I prefer working out alone. I can concentrate better without having to talk to anyone. I normally go swimming or use exercise equipment at the gym. Although my friends often invite me to join them, I find exercising by myself more enjoyable.

prefer exercising outside

I usually go jogging in the park because I prefer exercising outside rather than staying indoors. I sometimes work out at home when the weather is bad. I don't really enjoy going to the gym because it feels too crowded. I try to exercise several times a week to stay healthy.

just exercises in the morning

I'm quite busy with my studies, so I don't have much time for physical activities. I usually do some simple exercises in the morning before going to school. I sometimes go cycling at weekends, but I find it difficult to maintain a regular schedule. Morning exercise helps me feel more energetic throughout the day.

My shopping habits change dramatically ….=> has limited time for shopping

 

My shopping habits change dramatically depending on how busy I am. These days, I have a lot of work to do, so I don't have much time to visit shopping center or local stores. I usually plan my shopping carefully and only buy things when necessary. Online shopping is convenient, but I still enjoy visiting physical shops whenever I have enough free time.

I love shopping …=> tries to save money

 

I love shopping, especially when there are special offers and discounts. However, I always try to save money because I don't want to spend too much on unnecessary things. Before buying anything, I compare prices on different websites and look for discount codes. I also wait for big sales events to get the best deals.

I used to be interested in fashion…=> consider the environment when shopping

 

I used to be interested in fashion and bought new clothes quite frequently. However, I've started thinking more about the environment. Nowadays, I prefer buying second-hand clothes or products made from recycled materials. I also try to avoid unnecessary packaging and choose environmentally friendly products whenever possible.

Shopping is generally struggle for me….=> shops mainly on the internet

 

Shopping is generally a struggle for me because I don't enjoy walking around crowded shopping center. That's why I do most of my shopping on the Internet. I can easily compare products, read customer reviews and order things without leaving home. It's especially useful when I need to buy clothes, books or household items.

listening_2.stem: Four people are talking about a new restaurant. Complete the sentences below. (luyện nghe hiểu)

descriptions:
Person A : Were hungry after dinner

I went to a new Italian restaurant with my friends last Friday. The place looked lovely, and the waiter recommended the chef's special pasta. It tasted good, but the portion was really small. We also shared a salad and some bread, but when I got home, I still had to make myself a sandwich. So, overall, the food was nice, but it definitely wasn't enough for me.

Person B : ordered the wrong dish

I went to this restaurant with a friend last weekend because we had heard that it was popular. There were many different dishes on the menu, but the restaurant was especially famous for its chicken. I wanted to try it, but I was in a hurry and accidentally ordered the wrong dish. Luckily, the food I got was still really tasty, so I enjoyed it anyway. However, I'd like to come back another time and try the famous chicken dish.

Person C : met successful staff

I had dinner at a small Japanese restaurant yesterday. At first, I couldn't understand the menu because many dishes had unfamiliar names. Luckily, one of the staff members came over and explained everything patiently. She even suggested a dish without peanuts because I told her I had an allergy. The food was good, but what I appreciated most was how kind and helpful the staff were.

Person D : watched a nice performance

Last weekend, I went to a restaurant that had live music in the evening. The food was ordinary, and honestly, the drinks were a little expensive. But the singer and the band were fantastic. They played beautifully, and everyone in the restaurant stopped talking just to listen. It felt like a mini concert, and I couldn't find a single mistake in their performance.

listening_3.description:
Listen to two people discussing community design. Read the statements and decide whose opinion matches the best: the man’s, the woman’s or both. Who expresses which opinion?

 

Man: You know, I believe building design can shape people’s behaviors and interactions from the start. When spaces are designed well, people feel comfortable and naturally start connecting.

Woman: Of course, design matters, but there’s no shortcut to building real community connections. Creating community takes time and consistency, even in spaces that encourage interaction.

Man: Really? But I also feel that work communities and social communities aren’t as different as we might think. Both require spaces that help people feel connected and valued, whether it’s at work or in social settings.

Woman: I’m not sure I agree with that. Work communities and social communities serve very different purposes. In a social community, people gather out of personal interest and shared hobbies, but in work communities, people connect because of their job roles. That can affect how close they feel and how they interact with one another.

Man: I see your point, but even in work communities, people still find ways to connect on a personal level. A good work environment encourages friendships that might go beyond work topics.

Woman: That’s a good point. And with technology, people can now connect for both work and social reasons, even if they’re not physically together. But I still think it’s important to build spaces where people can gather in person.

Man: Yes, I agree, but I think technology has really changed how communities form. It makes connecting so much easier, and people don’t always need to meet face-to-face to feel a sense of community.

Woman: I see that, but I don’t think online connections can fully replace in-person gatherings. There’s a different energy when people come together in real spaces—something technology just can’t replicate.

Man: I understand, but I feel that virtual spaces can be just as meaningful. Technology adds a new layer, making it possible for communities to thrive even across distances, and that’s valuable in its own way.

listening_3.stem: Listen to two people discussing The subject of beauty. Read the statements and decide whose opinion matches the best: the man’s, the woman’s or both. Who expresses which opinion?
listening_3.description:
Man: Hi David. You look so serious reading while watching that beauty show. What happened?

 

Woman: You know, I’ve been thinking a lot about beauty lately. It seems like so many people share similar ideas about it, especially with social media showing the same types of looks and trends everywhere. It’s almost like there’s a formula for what’s considered beautiful.

 

Man: That’s a good point. However, I believe that ideas about beauty change over time. What we find beautiful today might not be the same in a few years. Just look at how fashion and beauty standards have shifted over the decades! Remember how popular certain hairstyles or clothing styles were?

 

Woman: It’s fascinating to see how those perceptions evolve. And I think beauty can be found in unexpected places too. For instance, when I walk through my neighborhood, I notice beauty not only in nature, like the way the sun sets or flowers bloom, but also in everyday moments—like a street musician playing a beautiful tune or people sharing a laugh.

 

Man: Those little things can be incredibly beautiful. And I think traditional ideas of beauty are going to change even more. People are starting to value authenticity and unique qualities rather than just sticking to old standards.

listening_3.stem: Listen to two people discussing the Audition - Actor. Read the opinions below and decide whose opinion matches the statements: the man, the woman, or both the man and the woman. You can listen to the discussion twice.
listening_3.description:
Man: You know, I’ve always believed that auditions are the most important part of an actor’s career. I mean, that’s where the magic happens. It doesn’t matter how great you are in rehearsals or even in the final performance; if you can’t nail that audition, you’re not getting anywhere. 

Woman: Yeah, but it’s not just about the audition. I’ve seen actors who can absolutely shine when they’re given the right material to work with. Strong scripts really bring out the best in them. If the writing’s weak, even a talented actor might struggle to connect. I think actors respond best when they feel inspired by what’s on the page. 

Man: That’s true, but whether it’s a strong script or a weak one, they still have to nail that first audition to even get the chance to perform, right? 

Woman: Sure, the audition is key, but once they’re in, the script can make or break their performance. It’s kind of a balance between both. 

Man: I agree with that. But I also think there’s a huge difference between theater acting and screen acting. The two require completely different skill sets. In theater, you’ve got to project and be larger than life, whereas on screen, it’s all about subtlety, keeping everything smaller and more contained. Woman: Absolutely! They’re such different worlds. The way you use your body, your voice, even how you interact with your fellow actors—it’s all completely different depending on whether you’re on stage or in front of a camera. 

Man: Right, and that’s why actors deserve as much praise as possible. They’re constantly shifting between styles and adapting to new roles. It’s tough! Woman: Couldn’t agree more. I mean, whether it’s theater or film, acting is such an emotional and demanding job. Encouragement and praise go a long way. They need to feel appreciated for all the work they put in.

listening_3.stem: Listen to two parents discussing Cultural Differences at Work. Read the opinions below and decide whose opinion matches the statements: the man, the woman, or both the man and the woman. You can listen to the discussion twice.
listening_3.description:
Man: You know, I think cultural differences can sometimes create misunderstandings in the workplace, especially when people come from very different backgrounds. However, I believe most people are quite forgiving when these situations happen. They usually understand that others may have different customs or communication styles, so they don't take every mistake personally.

Woman: I agree to some extent, but I think people sometimes exaggerate how different cultures really are. We often focus too much on the differences between countries, even though people actually share many similar values and expectations, particularly in professional environments.

Man: That's an interesting point. In fact, I believe there is something we could call an international business culture. Nowadays, companies around the world often follow similar professional standards, such as respecting deadlines, communicating clearly and working towards common goals. These shared practices make international cooperation much easier.

Woman: Perhaps, but I still think cultural differences can influence the way people behave at work. For example, some people prefer direct communication, while others consider it more polite to express their opinions indirectly.

Man: That's true. Nevertheless, I actually think it's a positive development that different cultures are becoming more alike. As international communication increases, people are learning from one another and adopting similar habits. This can reduce misunderstandings and make working together much easier.

Woman: I understand your point, although I don't think we should lose our cultural identities. Different traditions and ways of thinking can bring valuable perspectives to the workplace.

listening_3.stem: Listen to two parents discussing the The Internet. Read the opinions below and decide whose opinion matches the statements: the man, the woman, or both the man and the woman. You can listen to the discussion twice.
listening_3.description:
Man: Hi, Emma. You know, I've been thinking a lot about how much the internet has improved lately. It's really starting to shape the way our lives develop. 

Woman: Really? In what way? 

Man: Well, take a look at this article I found. It talks about how the internet influences everything - from how we learn to how we make decisions. 

Woman: Ah, so you're saying the internet gives us access to a lot of information? That's true in my opinion. 

Man: Hmm... not exactly. Not exactly. I think the information is helpful, but you actually need strong searching skills to find what's useful. And the problem is, too many people fall for fake news. 

Woman: That's a fair point. Just last week, I saw this post about a new product that promises fast weight loss. It had thousands of likes and comments, but when I looked into it, it turned out to be a complete scam. 

Man: That's a perfect example. I really believe there should be stricter control. Authorities need to take legal action and provide clearer guidelines. The internet has a huge impact on the way people think and behave. 

Woman: I'm not sure I agree with that part. I think we just need to be more careful when using the internet. People should take responsibility to double-check things before buying or sharing. If we bring in too many laws, we might limit people's freedom to express their opinions. 

Man: I get your point, but still, we can't ignore the damage some of this content causes. There's so much being created every second - especially short-form content. It's fast and addictive. And honestly, I think it's making young people more impatient. 

Woman: I completely agree. My younger cousin can't even sit through a one-minute video without skipping ahead. It's like no one wants to wait anymore. 

Man: Exactly. That's why I think some sort of regulation is necessary - not to control people's voices, but to help improve the quality of what we see online. That might help, as long as we don't go too far with these restrictions.

listening_3.stem: Listen to two people discussing Art.  Read the opinions below and decide whose opinion matches the statements: the man, the woman, or both the man and the woman. You can listen to the discussion twice.
listening_3.description:
Man: You know, I think art plays an important role in society, but unfortunately, not everyone has equal opportunities to enjoy it. Some people believe that art is mainly for wealthy or well-educated individuals who can afford expensive paintings, exhibitions and theatre performances.

Woman: I actually think that's true to some extent. In my opinion, art is only suitable for the privileged few. Many art exhibitions and cultural events are quite expensive, which makes them less accessible to ordinary people. Not everyone has the time or money to appreciate these activities.

Man: I understand your point, but I believe the government should do more to change this situation. It should invest more money in the arts, support local artists and provide free or affordable cultural activities for the public.

Woman: That's a reasonable suggestion. I also think we should pay more attention to art education, especially for children.

Man: Absolutely! Children should be exposed to art from an early age. Visiting museums, learning to draw and taking part in creative activities can help them develop their imagination and express their feelings.

Woman: I couldn't agree more. Early exposure to art can also help children become more creative and appreciate different forms of culture.

Man: And I'm quite optimistic about the future. With the development of technology, online exhibitions and digital platforms, I believe art will become more accessible to everyone. People will be able to explore famous artworks without having to travel or pay expensive entrance fees.

Woman: That's possible. Technology certainly creates more opportunities, although I think traditional galleries and museums will still remain important.

listening_3.stem: Listen to two parents discussing Singers and Music. Read the opinions below and decide whose opinion matches the statements: the man, the woman, or both the man and the woman. You can listen to the discussion twice.
listening_3.description:
Man:  You know, I’m not entirely convinced that singers are good role models for young people. While some may have positive messages, others don’t always set the best example. Sometimes their lifestyles can be quite the opposite of what we’d want kids to emulate.

Woman: I actually disagree. I believe that singers can play a positive role in young people's lives. Their influence can inspire kids to pursue their dreams and express themselves. Just think about how many young artists start singing because they look up to someone famous.

Man: Fair point, but I still think young people should be careful about whom they admire. Not every famous artist deserves to be a role model.

Woman: That's true, but many singers, such as Taylor Swift and Ed Sheeran, often promote kindness, hard work and positive values.

Man : I get that. But when it comes to taste in music, it’s such a highly personal thing. What resonates with one person might not resonate with another. I mean, I might love rock while my friend prefers classical!

Woman: Absolutely! Everyone has their own preferences, and that’s what makes music so interesting. It’s like a reflection of our individual personalities. 

Man : And speaking of music, I believe it’s a universal language that connects people from different cultures. You can go anywhere in the world and find someone who enjoys music.

Woman: I don’t fully agree with that. While music can connect people, its meanings can vary greatly between cultures. A song that makes one group happy might not even be understood by another.

Man : True, but one thing we can both agree on is that music can be used to manipulate people’s feelings, whether in advertising or emotional moments in movies.

Woman : Definitely! It’s amazing how a song can evoke such strong emotions in us. Just think about those movie soundtracks that give you chills or make you cry. Music has that incredible power.

Man : Right? It’s fascinating how a simple melody can tap into our emotions so deeply.

listening_3.stem: Listen to two parents discussing Urban Farming. Read the opinions below and decide whose opinion matches the statements: the man, the woman, or both the man and the woman. You can listen to the discussion twice.
listening_3.description:
Man: You know, I think urban farming is a great idea, but we need to be realistic about the limited space in cities. Buildings, houses and other facilities should come first. People need somewhere to live, so I don't think farming areas should take up too much valuable space.

Woman: I see your point, but I believe living space is definitely more important than farming space. Cities are becoming increasingly crowded, and providing enough housing for residents should be the priority. We shouldn't sacrifice people's homes just to create more farms.

Man: That's true. However, urban farms don't have to look unattractive. In fact, I think they can make cities more beautiful. Rooftop gardens, green walls and small community farms can turn empty spaces into attractive green areas.

Woman: Absolutely, but I also think urban farming can bring other benefits. It may help people access fresh vegetables more easily.

Man: Definitely! Another advantage is that urban farming can support the local economy. It creates job opportunities, encourages small businesses and allows local farmers to sell fresh produce directly to nearby customers.

Woman: That's a good point. And considering how quickly urban populations are growing, we really need more food available in cities. Many people depend on food transported from distant places, so producing more locally could be very helpful.

Man: I completely agree. The demand for food in urban areas is increasing, and urban farming could help us meet that demand. It would also reduce our dependence on food supplies from other regions.

listening_3.stem: Listen to two parents discussing the changes in the workplace. Read the opinions below and decide whose opinion matches the statements: the man, the woman, or both the man and the woman. You can listen to the discussion twice.
listening_3.description:
Man: It seems like every workplace is going through so many changes lately. But honestly, I think Continuity is still very important. When things remain steady, it gives people a sense of security. If everything changes too fast, it’s hard for employees to keep up and the organization can lose its way. Continuity is important in keeping everyone focused. 

Woman: I get where you're coming from, but I feel like these days, nothing is certain. Job security isn't something we can rely on anymore. There’s always the risk of layoffs, especially with the economy being unpredictable. People are moving from job to job more than ever before, and you can’t always count on staying in one place for long. 

Man: That’s definitely a concern. But regardless of job security or stability, one thing we both can agree on is that job satisfaction is a huge motivator. When people love what they do, they’re more likely to stay, even when times get tough. It’s the main reason many of us keep pushing through the challenges. 

Woman: Absolutely! I think when people are satisfied with their work, they’re willing to go the extra mile. It’s not just about the paycheck; it’s about feeling fulfilled. That’s what really makes the difference in the workplace. 

Man: You’re right. And another thing that’s making a difference is technology. It’s been a game-changer for the economy, making things faster and more efficient. The growth we’ve seen in so many industries is because of how we’ve embraced new technologies. It’s definitely helping businesses thrive.

listening_3.stem: Listen to two parents discussing the cultural center.  Read the opinions below and decide whose opinion matches the statements: the man, the woman, or both the man and the woman. You can listen to the discussion twice.
listening_3.description:
Man: You know, I think cultural centers play an important role in preserving local traditions. However, I'm worried that many traditional customs are gradually losing their significance as younger generations become more interested in modern lifestyles.

Woman: I completely agree. Nowadays, fewer young people seem interested in traditional activities, and some old customs are no longer practiced as regularly as they used to be. We really need to do something to keep our cultural heritage alive.

Man: That's true. I'm also concerned about local festivals. Many of them are attracting fewer visitors every year. If this trend continues, I believe some local festivals will disappear completely in the near future.

Woman: That's a real possibility. Perhaps cultural centers could organize more interesting exhibitions to encourage people to learn about their heritage.

Man: Good idea! But I think these exhibitions should focus mainly on traditional objects and historical events.

Woman: I don't quite agree. I believe exhibitions should be different and diverse. They should include traditional art, modern culture, local food and even interactive activities. This would attract people of different ages and interests.

Man: That's an interesting suggestion. Another thing we shouldn't overlook is education. Schools are particularly important in shaping future generations because children need to understand their cultural roots from an early age. Teachers should introduce more lessons about local history and traditions.

Woman: Absolutely. Schools can certainly help children appreciate their cultural identity, although families and communities also have an important role to play.

listening_3.stem: Listen to two parents discussing Homeschooling. Read the opinions below and decide whose opinion matches the statements: the man, the woman, or both the man and the woman. You can listen to the discussion twice.
listening_3.description:
Man: You know, I think homeschooling can be a good alternative to traditional education, but parents need to be well-prepared. In my opinion, they should create their own curriculum based on their children's abilities, interests and learning needs rather than simply following standard textbooks.

Woman: That's an interesting point. However, I sometimes wonder whether homeschooling is suitable for families with several children. Teaching them all at home could be quite challenging, especially when they are at different educational levels.

Man: I understand your concern, but I actually think homeschooling multiple children at the same time can be a good idea. They can study together, share learning experiences and even help one another with difficult subjects.

Woman: I agree to some extent. In fact, siblings can benefit from learning together. But my biggest concern is that homeschooling may deprive children of important social interaction. At school, they have opportunities to make friends, work in groups and develop communication skills. These experiences are not always easy to provide at home.

Man: That's a fair point. Nevertheless, parents can arrange outdoor activities and social events to help their children interact with others. However, I believe homeschooling may become less popular in the future because more families are recognizing the advantages of traditional schools and modern educational facilities.

Woman: Perhaps you're right. Schools also offer professional teachers, organized activities and opportunities for children to build friendships. I think these advantages are difficult for homeschooling to replace completely.

listening_3.description:
Listen to two people discussing children and teenagers' use of technology. Read the statements and decide whose opinion matches the best: the man's, the woman's or both. Who expresses which opinion?

 

Man: I've been thinking about how children and young people use technology nowadays. They seem very interested in learning through computers, tablets, and educational apps.

Woman: I agree. Technology-based lessons can make learning more enjoyable, and many children are excited to use digital tools in class.

Man: However, I think technology can also affect their communication skills. Some children spend so much time online that they find it difficult to communicate with people face to face.

Woman: Yes, I've noticed that too. They may feel confident when sending messages, but they sometimes struggle to have conversations without using a device.

Man: Another problem is that many families don't know how to manage their children's use of technology. I think parents need more support and guidance to set appropriate rules at home.

Woman: That may be true, but I also believe children can learn to control their own online behaviour. With proper education, they can understand when to stop using technology and how to interact responsibly online.

Woman: Still, we should recognize that no matter how advanced they get, computers can’t replicate the complexity of the human brain. Our ability to think critically and empathize is irreplaceable, and we need to nurture those qualities even as we embrace new technologies. 

Man: I see. However, while we’re advancing, I believe we both see the need for stronger protections around individual privacy. As we rely more on the internet, safeguarding personal information becomes increasingly important. 

Woman: Exactly! Protecting privacy is essential in this digital age. We have to ensure that people maintain control over their data, balancing innovation with the right to privacy.

Topic: Sports competitions


Many people question whether sports are beneficial or harmful to children's development. This is not an easy question to answer. Sports are often understood as inherently competitive, which makes it debatable whether they are good or bad. However, when the competitive element is excluded, sports play a crucial role in children's development. They provide opportunities for socializing and learning essential life skills that are not typically taught in the classroom, such as teamwork, communication, and resilience.

On the other hand, competitive sports can have negative effects. By this, I mean that constantly comparing one child to another to determine who is better or worse can be harmful. Many students thrive in neutral, active environments where cooperation is encouraged, rather than in competitive settings. It is extremely important to recognize that sports are essential for children's development, serving as a counterbalance to the academic focus of classrooms. Schools should view sports not as a means of fostering competition, but as a way to promote cooperation, physical wellness, and holistic growth.

Dịch:

1/ Chúng có tác động tiêu cực

2/ Mang lại cho họ sự cân bằng trong cuộc sống

Mẹo: Thể thao có cả tác động tiêu cực và cung cấp cân bằng

 

Chủ đề: Thi đấu thể thao

Nhiều người đặt câu hỏi liệu thể thao có mang lại lợi ích hay gây ảnh hưởng tiêu cực đến sự phát triển của trẻ em. Đây không phải là một câu hỏi dễ trả lời.

Thể thao thường được hiểu là một hoạt động mang tính cạnh tranh, vì vậy việc chúng tốt hay xấu đối với trẻ em vẫn còn gây tranh luận. Tuy nhiên, khi yếu tố cạnh tranh được loại bỏ, thể thao đóng vai trò rất quan trọng trong sự phát triển của trẻ. Thể thao tạo cơ hội cho trẻ giao lưu và học những kỹ năng sống thiết yếu mà thường không được dạy trong lớp học, chẳng hạn như làm việc nhóm, giao tiếp và khả năng vượt qua khó khăn.

Mặt khác, các môn thể thao mang tính cạnh tranh có thể gây ra những tác động tiêu cực. Ở đây, tôi muốn nói đến việc liên tục so sánh trẻ này với trẻ khác để xác định ai giỏi hơn hoặc kém hơn, điều này có thể gây hại cho trẻ. Nhiều học sinh phát triển tốt trong những môi trường tích cực, không đặt nặng cạnh tranh, nơi sự hợp tác được khuyến khích thay vì cạnh tranh.

Điều vô cùng quan trọng là phải nhận ra rằng thể thao rất cần thiết cho sự phát triển của trẻ, bởi nó tạo ra sự cân bằng với việc tập trung quá nhiều vào học tập trong lớp học. Nhà trường nên xem thể thao không phải là một phương tiện để thúc đẩy cạnh tranh, mà là cách để khuyến khích sự hợp tác, nâng cao sức khỏe thể chất và phát triển trẻ một cách toàn diện.

Topic: A newly released novel


Good evening, everyone! Today, we’re excited to talk about the latest novel by popular author James Parker. He is known for his softer, romantic stories like Whispers of the Heart, which have touched the hearts of many readers. However, his new novel, Shadow in the Night, is quite different. In Shadow in the Night, Parker explores a thrilling world of suspense and mystery. He moves away from his gentle love stories to deliver an exciting plot filled with unexpected twists. The tension in this book is much higher, showing that he can write in different styles. While many readers are excited about this new direction, I believe it’s important for Parker to pay attention to the critics’ advice as he works on his next book. Their feedback can help him improve his writing and find the right balance between romance and thrill that fans appreciate. Stay tuned for more updates on this talented author!

Transcript:

Topic: A book about the life of a scientist


Reviewer: Today, I want to share my thoughts on a fascinating book about the life of renowned scientist Dr. Emily Carter. One of the standout features of this book is that the way of writing is exciting for readers. The author has a talent for bringing complex scientific concepts to life, making it an engaging experience. While some may expect a heavy focus on technical details, this book skillfully balances science with storytelling, ensuring that it remains accessible. It's definitely not more of a textbook than a biography; instead, it invites readers into the scientist's world in a relatable way.

Overall, I'd say it has been written for a general audience. The author's aim seems to be to inspire curiosity about science and encourage readers from all backgrounds to appreciate the contributions of Dr. Carter. Unlike other works that are only suitable for experts in the field, this book truly welcomes everyone to explore the life of an extraordinary scientist.

Cuốn sách chắc chắn không giống một cuốn giáo trình hơn là một cuốn tiểu sử; thay vào đó, nó đưa người đọc bước vào thế giới của nhà khoa học theo một cách gần gũi, dễ hiểu.

Nhìn chung, tôi cho rằng cuốn sách được viết dành cho độc giả nói chung. Mục đích của tác giả dường như là khơi dậy sự tò mò về khoa học và khuyến khích độc giả thuộc mọi hoàn cảnh trân trọng những đóng góp của Tiến sĩ Carter.

Không giống những tác phẩm khác chỉ phù hợp với các chuyên gia trong lĩnh vực này, cuốn sách thực sự chào đón tất cả mọi người cùng khám phá cuộc đời của một nhà khoa học phi thường.

listening_4.stem: Listen to a reporter talk about working from home and answer the questions below.
listening_4.description:
It wasn't as good as she expected

It depends on your situation and personality

 

Làm việc ở nhà không tốt như mong đợi vì tùy trường hợp

 

Transcript:

Topic: Working from home


Working from home has its pros and cons, and I have mixed feelings about it. On one hand, I find that I work effectively without the distractions of my colleagues chatting. However, later, I got distracted by other things around the house, such as the dirty laundry or the unwashed dishes. I can focus on my tasks and complete them much faster. It’s nice to set my own schedule and take breaks when I want. However, working from home is not as good as I expected. I sometimes feel lonely without the social interaction from the office. Video calls are helpful, but they can't replace face-to-face conversations. You don't need a big home office to be productive; a small corner of your room can work just fine. Still, it's important to stay self-motivated, which can be challenging at times. After all, how well you work from home really depends on your situation and personality. Some people thrive in this environment, while others struggle. Overall, I am learning to balance my work and personal life better as I adjust to this new way of working.

Đáp án 

1. Nó không tốt như cô ấy đã kỳ vọng

Mẹo: Làm việc ở nhà không tốt như mong đợi vì tùy trường hợp

 

Chủ đề: Làm việc tại nhà

 

Làm việc tại nhà có cả ưu điểm và nhược điểm, và tôi có những cảm nhận trái chiều về điều đó. Một mặt, tôi thấy mình làm việc hiệu quả khi không bị đồng nghiệp trò chuyện làm mất tập trung. Tuy nhiên, sau đó, tôi lại bị phân tâm bởi những thứ khác trong nhà, chẳng hạn như quần áo bẩn hoặc bát đĩa chưa rửa.

Tôi có thể tập trung vào công việc và hoàn thành chúng nhanh hơn nhiều. Thật thoải mái khi tôi có thể tự sắp xếp lịch làm việc và nghỉ giải lao bất cứ khi nào mình muốn. Tuy nhiên, làm việc tại nhà không tốt như tôi đã kỳ vọng. Tôi đôi khi cảm thấy cô đơn vì thiếu sự tương tác xã hội ở văn phòng. Các cuộc gọi video rất hữu ích, nhưng không thể thay thế những cuộc trò chuyện trực tiếp.

Bạn không cần một phòng làm việc tại nhà thật lớn để làm việc hiệu quả; một góc nhỏ trong phòng cũng hoàn toàn có thể phù hợp. Tuy vậy, điều quan trọng là phải duy trì động lực làm việc, và đôi khi điều này khá khó khăn.

Sau cùng, việc bạn làm việc tại nhà hiệu quả đến đâu thực sự phụ thuộc vào hoàn cảnh và tính cách của bạn. Một số người phát huy tốt trong môi trường này, trong khi những người khác lại gặp khó khăn.

Nhìn chung, tôi đang học cách cân bằng công việc và cuộc sống cá nhân tốt hơn khi thích nghi với cách làm việc mới này.

Transcript: 

Topic: Life after university


Life after university is quite an adventure, and I've learned a lot since graduating last year. The biggest change I've noticed is how different my daily routine is now. Unlike during my university days, I don't have a fixed schedule of classes and study sessions anymore. This has actually made me more adaptable and willing to try new things. I've found myself saying 'yes' to opportunities I might have passed up before, whether it's joining a new club or learning a new skill for work. Speaking of work, the job market was quite an eye-opener. I always heard that finding a job would be tough, but I didn't realize just how fierce the competition would be. It seems like every position has dozens, if not hundreds, of applicants. This means you really have to stand out to get noticed. On the bright side, this competitive environment has pushed me to improve my skills and broaden my network. I've attended more networking events in the past year than I ever did at university. While the job search can be stressful at times, I've found that staying positive and being open to different possibilities has helped me navigate this new chapter of my life.

Cuộc sống sau khi tốt nghiệp đại học giống như một cuộc phiêu lưu, và tôi đã học được rất nhiều điều kể từ khi tốt nghiệp vào năm ngoái.

Thay đổi lớn nhất mà tôi nhận thấy là lịch sinh hoạt hằng ngày của tôi bây giờ khác rất nhiều. Không giống như thời đại học, tôi không còn có thời gian biểu cố định cho các buổi học và thời gian học tập nữa. Điều này thực sự khiến tôi dễ thích nghi hơn và cởi mở hơn, đồng thời sẵn sàng thử những điều mới.

Tôi nhận thấy mình thường nói “có” với những cơ hội mà trước đây có thể tôi đã bỏ qua, chẳng hạn như tham gia một câu lạc bộ mới hoặc học một kỹ năng mới phục vụ công việc.

Nói về công việc, thị trường lao động thực sự khiến tôi mở mang tầm mắt. Tôi luôn nghe nói rằng tìm việc sẽ rất khó, nhưng tôi không nhận ra rằng sự cạnh tranh lại gay gắt đến vậy. Có vẻ như mỗi vị trí đều có hàng chục, thậm chí hàng trăm ứng viên. Điều này có nghĩa là bạn thực sự phải tạo được sự khác biệt để được chú ý.

Mặt tích cực là môi trường cạnh tranh  này đã thúc đẩy tôi cải thiện kỹ năng và mở rộng mạng lưới quan hệ. Trong năm qua, tôi đã tham gia nhiều sự kiện kết nối hơn cả thời còn học đại học.

Mặc dù quá trình tìm việc đôi khi có thể gây căng thẳng, tôi nhận thấy rằng duy trì thái độ tích cực và cởi mở với những khả năng khác nhau đã giúp tôi vượt qua chương mới này của cuộc đời.

Transcript: 

Topic: A research in happiness

Good morning, listeners! Today, we're diving into a recent research study on happiness that has sparked quite a bit of discussion. Unfortunately, it seems that the media has focused more on sensational headlines rather than accurately reporting the core findings of the research. As a result, many people are left with a distorted understanding of what truly contributes to happiness. While numerous studies have attempted to uncover the secrets to a happy life, it's important to recognize that there may never be a conclusive answer. Happiness is a complex and personal experience, influenced by a variety of factors unique to each individual. Instead of seeking a one-size-fits-all solution, we should focus on understanding our own needs and values. Remember, happiness is not a destination but a journey, and it's crucial to approach it with an open mind. Stay tuned for more insights and discussions on this fascinating topic!

Chủ đề: Nghiên cứu về hạnh phúc

 

Chào buổi sáng, thính giả! Hôm nay, chúng ta sẽ tìm hiểu về một nghiên cứu gần đây về hạnh phúc, nghiên cứu này đã gây ra khá nhiều tranh luận.

Đáng tiếc là có vẻ như truyền thông tập trung nhiều hơn vào những tiêu đề giật gân thay vì đưa tin chính xác về những phát hiện cốt lõi của nghiên cứu. Vì vậy, nhiều người có một cách hiểu sai lệch về những yếu tố thực sự góp phần tạo nên hạnh phúc.

Mặc dù nhiều nghiên cứu đã cố gắng khám phá bí quyết để có một cuộc sống hạnh phúc, điều quan trọng cần nhận ra là có lẽ sẽ không bao giờ có một câu trả lời rõ ràng và chắc chắn.

Hạnh phúc là một trải nghiệm phức tạp và mang tính cá nhân, chịu ảnh hưởng bởi nhiều yếu tố khác nhau và riêng biệt đối với mỗi người.

Thay vì tìm kiếm một giải pháp phù hợp với tất cả mọi người, chúng ta nên tập trung vào việc hiểu nhu cầu và giá trị của chính mình.

Hãy nhớ rằng, hạnh phúc không phải là một đích đến mà là một hành trình, và điều quan trọng là chúng ta cần tiếp cận nó với một tâm thế cởi mở.

2. Refuse to seek advice from others

Transcript: 

Topic: Experience in writing


 

Hi everyone! I’d like to share my experience with writer's block during the process of writing my new bestseller. Many people think that to write well, you need to sit down every day for 15 to 20 minutes or find a quiet space. While those strategies work for some, I’ve found that establishing specific time slots for writing that truly fit my style is what helps me the most. However, I did face significant writer’s block at one point, and looking back, I regret not reaching out for guidance from others. I thought I could handle everything on my own, but sometimes it’s vital to get an outside perspective. Talking to fellow writers and mentors could have helped me overcome that block much faster. Now I understand that collaboration and sharing ideas can inspire creativity. So, if you ever find yourself stuck, don’t hesitate to reach out to others!

Xin chào mọi người! Tôi muốn chia sẻ kinh nghiệm của mình về tình trạng bí ý tưởng khi viết trong quá trình viết cuốn sách bán chạy mới của mình.

Nhiều người nghĩ rằng để viết tốt, bạn cần ngồi xuống viết mỗi ngày trong 15 đến 20 phút hoặc tìm một không gian yên tĩnh. Tuy nhiên, đã có lúc tôi thực sự gặp phải tình trạng bí ý tưởng nghiêm trọng, và nhìn lại, tôi hối tiếc vì đã không tìm đến người khác để xin lời khuyên. Tôi nghĩ mình có thể tự giải quyết mọi thứ, nhưng đôi khi việc có được một góc nhìn từ bên ngoài là vô cùng quan trọng.

Trò chuyện với những người viết khác và các cố vấn có thể đã giúp tôi vượt qua tình trạng bí ý tưởng nhanh hơn rất nhiều. Bây giờ tôi hiểu rằng việc hợp tác và chia sẻ ý tưởng có thể truyền cảm hứng cho sự sáng tạo.

 

Vì vậy, nếu bạn từng cảm thấy bế tắc, đừng ngần ngại tìm đến người khác!

Transcript: 

Topic: Professionalism at work


Good morning, everyone! Today, I want to talk about professionalism and how it has changed over the years. To be seen as a professional, it’s essential to be friendly, open-minded, and willing to help others. An optimistic attitude not only makes a good impression but also creates a better work environment. Additionally, with the rapid changes in technology and globalization, our definition of professionalism is no longer the same as it was 40 years ago. In the past, being professional often meant simply dressing well and following strict rules. Now, it includes being adaptable, understanding different cultures, and using technology effectively. As we continue to evolve in our careers, we must embrace these changes and redefine what it means to be a professional. By doing so, we can better meet the needs of our diverse workplaces and succeed in today’s fast-paced world. Thank you!

Topic: Professionalism at work


Good morning, everyone! Today, I want to talk about professionalism and how it has changed over the years. To be seen as a professional, it’s essential to be friendly, open-minded, and willing to help others. An optimistic attitude not only makes a good impression but also creates a better work environment. Additionally, with the rapid changes in technology and globalization, our definition of professionalism is no longer the same as it was 40 years ago. In the past, being professional often meant simply dressing well and following strict rules. Now, it includes being adaptable, understanding different cultures, and using technology effectively. As we continue to evolve in our careers, we must embrace these changes and redefine what it means to be a professional. By doing so, we can better meet the needs of our diverse workplaces and succeed in today’s fast-paced world. Thank you!

Chào buổi sáng mọi người! Hôm nay, tôi muốn nói về tính chuyên nghiệp và cách nó đã thay đổi qua nhiều năm.

Để được nhìn nhận là một người chuyên nghiệp, điều cần thiết là phải thân thiện, cởi mở và sẵn sàng giúp đỡ người khác. Một thái độ lạc quan không chỉ tạo ấn tượng tốt mà còn tạo ra một môi trường làm việc tốt hơn.

Ngoài ra, cùng với những thay đổi nhanh chóng của công nghệ và quá trình toàn cầu hóa, định nghĩa của chúng ta về tính chuyên nghiệp không còn giống như cách đây 40 năm. Trước đây, chuyên nghiệp thường chỉ có nghĩa là ăn mặc đẹp và tuân thủ những quy tắc nghiêm ngặt.

Ngày nay, nó bao gồm khả năng thích nghi, hiểu các nền văn hóa khác nhau và sử dụng công nghệ một cách hiệu quả.

 

Khi chúng ta tiếp tục phát triển trong sự nghiệp, chúng ta phải đón nhận những thay đổi này và định nghĩa lại thế nào là một người chuyên nghiệp. Làm như vậy sẽ giúp chúng ta đáp ứng tốt hơn nhu cầu của môi trường làm việc đa dạng và thành công trong thế giới thay đổi nhanh chóng ngày nay.

listening_4.description:

People should feel reassured about their presence

 

Mẹo: Camera an ninh khiến mọi người lo lắng về sự hiện diện

 

Transcript

Topic: Security camera
I've noticed that some of my coworkers get a bit nervous about the security cameras in our office. They often say things like, 'It feels like we're being watched all the time,' or 'I don't like feeling like I'm not trusted.' But honestly, I think people worry too much about it. These cameras aren't there to spy on us or catch us doing something wrong. They're actually there to keep us safe. I mean, think about it - if something were to happen, like a theft or an accident, wouldn't you want there to be a record of it? Plus, knowing the cameras are there can actually prevent bad things from happening in the first place. I believe that once people understand the real purpose of these cameras, they'll feel much better about them. Instead of feeling worried, we should feel glad that our company cares about our safety. It's just one more way they're looking out for us while we're at work. You know, I remember when we first got the cameras installed. Some people were really upset about it. But after a while, most of us hardly even notice them anymore. They're just part of the background now. And there have been times when they've been really helpful. Like when someone's bag went missing, the cameras helped us figure out what happened. I think it's important to remember that these cameras are in public areas, not in private spaces like bathrooms or changing rooms. They're not meant to invade our privacy, just to make sure everyone follows the rules and stays safe. In the end, I think having them makes our workplace better for everyone. It's a small thing that can make a big difference in keeping us all secure.

raw_metadata.explanation:
Dịch

  • Mọi người lo lắng không cần thiết về chúng.
  • Mọi người nên cảm thấy yên tâm về sự hiện diện của chúng.
  • Mẹo: Camera an ninh khiến mọi người lo lắng về sự hiện diện

  •  

  • Chủ đề: Camera an ninh

    Tôi nhận thấy rằng một số đồng nghiệp của tôi cảm thấy hơi lo lắng về những chiếc camera an ninh trong văn phòng. Họ thường nói những điều như: “Cảm giác như chúng ta luôn bị theo dõi” hoặc “Tôi không thích cảm giác mình không được tin tưởng.”

    Nhưng thành thật mà nói, tôi nghĩ mọi người lo lắng quá mức về chuyện này. Những chiếc camera này không được lắp đặt để theo dõi chúng ta hay bắt quả tang chúng ta làm điều gì sai. Thực ra, chúng được sử dụng để giữ cho chúng ta an toàn.

    Hãy thử nghĩ xem – nếu có chuyện gì xảy ra, chẳng hạn như một vụ trộm hoặc một tai nạn, chẳng phải bạn sẽ muốn có một đoạn ghi hình về sự việc đó sao? Hơn nữa, việc biết rằng có camera ở đó thực sự có thể ngăn những điều xấu xảy ra ngay từ đầu.

    Tôi tin rằng một khi mọi người hiểu được mục đích thực sự của những chiếc camera này, họ sẽ cảm thấy tốt hơn về chúng. Thay vì cảm thấy lo lắng, chúng ta nên cảm thấy vui vì công ty quan tâm đến sự an toàn của chúng ta. Đây chỉ là một cách khác mà công ty đang quan tâm và bảo vệ chúng ta khi chúng ta làm việc.

    Tôi nhớ khi những chiếc camera lần đầu tiên được lắp đặt. Một số người thực sự rất khó chịu về điều đó. Nhưng sau một thời gian, hầu hết chúng tôi hầu như không còn để ý đến chúng nữa. Bây giờ chúng chỉ đơn giản là một phần của không gian xung quanh.

    Và đã có những lúc camera thực sự rất hữu ích. Ví dụ, khi túi của một người nào đó bị mất, camera đã giúp chúng tôi tìm hiểu chuyện gì đã xảy ra.

    Tôi nghĩ điều quan trọng là phải nhớ rằng những chiếc camera này được đặt ở khu vực công cộng, chứ không phải những nơi riêng tư như phòng tắm hay phòng thay đồ. Chúng không nhằm xâm phạm quyền riêng tư của chúng ta mà chỉ để đảm bảo mọi người tuân thủ các quy định và giữ an toàn.

    Cuối cùng, tôi nghĩ việc có camera khiến nơi làm việc trở nên tốt hơn cho tất cả mọi người. Đó là một điều nhỏ nhưng có thể tạo ra sự khác biệt lớn trong việc giữ cho tất cả chúng ta được an toàn.

Transcript.

Topic: A new guidebook


Recently I decided to purchase a new guide book before my latest trip and I have to say It completely transformed my travel experience. This guidebook is designed to inspire exploration and curiosity. Instead of simply listing famous landmarks, it encourages readers to step off the beaten path and discover hidden gems. For example, it includes local stories, unique activities, and tips for immersing oneself in the culture of the places they visit. Some might think it is a little bit difficult to navigate, but in reality, it makes each journey feel like an adventure, allowing travelers to create unforgettable memories and experiences that go beyond the typical sightseeing. This guidebook resonates well with younger travelers today. Some say it's only for seasoned explorers because it focuses on local cultures, which beginners might find confusing. Others think it's outdated for those who prefer modern apps. However, it encourages real connections and unique experiences, helping travelers engage with locals.

Chủ đề: Một cuốn sách hướng dẫn mới


 

Gần đây, tôi quyết định mua một cuốn sách hướng dẫn du lịch mới trước chuyến đi gần đây nhất của mình, và tôi phải nói rằng nó đã hoàn toàn thay đổi trải nghiệm du lịch của tôi.

Cuốn sách hướng dẫn này được thiết kế để khơi gợi sự khám phá và tò mò. Thay vì chỉ liệt kê những địa danh nổi tiếng, nó khuyến khích người đọc rời khỏi những con đường quen thuộc và khám phá những địa điểm ít người biết đến. Ví dụ, nó cung cấp những câu chuyện địa phương, các hoạt động độc đáo và những mẹo để hòa mình vào văn hóa của những nơi mà họ đến.

Một số người có thể nghĩ rằng cuốn sách hơi khó sử dụng, nhưng thực tế, nó khiến mỗi chuyến đi giống như một cuộc phiêu lưu. Nó giúp du khách tạo ra những kỷ niệm và trải nghiệm đáng nhớ, vượt xa việc chỉ tham quan những địa điểm thông thường.

Cuốn sách hướng dẫn này phù hợp với thế hệ trẻ ngày nay. Một số người cho rằng nó chỉ dành cho những người đã có nhiều kinh nghiệm khám phá, bởi vì nó tập trung vào văn hóa địa phương, điều mà người mới bắt đầu có thể thấy khó hiểu. Những người khác lại nghĩ rằng nó đã lỗi thời đối với những người thích sử dụng các ứng dụng hiện đại.

Tuy nhiên, cuốn sách khuyến khích những mối liên kết thực sự và những trải nghiệm độc đáo, giúp du khách giao lưu và kết nối với người dân địa phương.

2. They need to make the customers feel valued and welcome

Transcript: 

Topic: A restaurant Baloo

As someone who’s reviewed dining experiences for years, I was looking forward to my visit to La Bella Bistro. The location and ambiance are certainly inviting; however, my overall experience left much to be desired. While the food itself was decent, the real issue lies with the service. From the moment I arrived, it was clear that the staff were either overwhelmed or under-trained. I had to wait far too long for basic requests, and when I did finally receive attention, it was rushed and impersonal. This level of service really detracts from what should be a pleasant evening out. Now, in an age where online food delivery has become so convenient, restaurants need to focus on what sets them apart. What can compete with the ease of ordering from home is the feeling of being truly valued and welcomed. Diners aren’t just looking for good food; they want an experience. A warm greeting, attentive service, and the sense that their presence matters – these are the things that make customers want to return. Unfortunately, at La Bella Bistro, that element was noticeably lacking, and it's something they need to address if they hope to stand out in today's competitive market.

Chủ đề: Nhà hàng La Bella Bistro

Là một người đã đánh giá các trải nghiệm ăn uống trong nhiều năm, tôi rất mong chờ chuyến ghé thăm La Bella Bistro. Địa điểm và không gian của nhà hàng chắc chắn rất hấp dẫn; tuy nhiên, trải nghiệm tổng thể của tôi lại không được như mong đợi.

Mặc dù đồ ăn khá ổn, vấn đề thực sự nằm ở dịch vụ. Ngay từ khi tôi đến, rõ ràng là nhân viên hoặc đang bị quá tải, hoặc chưa được đào tạo đầy đủ. Tôi phải chờ quá lâu cho những yêu cầu cơ bản, và khi cuối cùng cũng được nhân viên chú ý, cách phục vụ lại rất vội vàng và thiếu sự quan tâm.

Chất lượng phục vụ này thực sự làm giảm đi một buổi tối đáng lẽ phải rất dễ chịu. 

Ngày nay, khi dịch vụ giao đồ ăn trực tuyến đã trở nên rất tiện lợi, các nhà hàng cần tập trung vào điều gì khiến họ khác biệt. Điều có thể cạnh tranh với sự tiện lợi của việc đặt đồ ăn tại nhà chính là cảm giác được thực sự coi trọng và chào đón. 

Khách hàng không chỉ tìm kiếm đồ ăn ngon; họ muốn có một trải nghiệm. Một lời chào thân thiện, sự phục vụ chu đáo và cảm giác rằng sự hiện diện của họ được coi trọng — đó là những điều khiến khách hàng muốn quay lại.

Đáng tiếc là tại La Bella Bistro, yếu tố đó rõ ràng còn thiếu, và đây là điều họ cần cải thiện nếu muốn nổi bật trong thị trường cạnh tranh ngày nay.
